comment: He is a lazy guy. The response email to your question is really short and meaningless. Sometimes, he even doesn't respond to your email. Before the test, other teachers will have extra office hours or remind you about what you need to review, but he didn't do anything. He even didn't send a reminder email. You have to do all by yourself.

He does not explain the concepts well in class and asking questions usually ends up further confusing you. All quizzes/tests are online, but there is a stark difference in the way he teaches VS the textbook... and the questions are generated via the textbook. Good luck.
